sermon.title: The Power of the Manifestation of Jesus Christ - 9/10/2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Jesus spoke clearly about what we must do. Power comes after the Holy Spirit comes upon us, as the Spirit of truth and the cleansing word work in us. Jesus was anointed with the Holy Ghost and power and healed the oppressed; the church needs not just His presence by faith but His manifestation, so the world will believe.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And further, my son, be admonished by these. Of making many books there is no end, and much study is wearisome to the flesh.
And he brought them out and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

Therefore bear fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones. And even now the ax is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.” So the people asked him, saying, “What shall we do then?” He answered and said to them, “He who has two tunics, let him give to him who has none; and he who has food, let him do likewise.” Then tax collectors also came to be baptized, and said to him, “Teacher, what shall we do?” And he said to them, “Collect no more than what is appointed for you.” Likewise the soldiers asked him, saying, “And what shall we do?” So he said to them, “Do not intimidate anyone or accuse falsely, and be content with your wages.”

faqs.question: How many books try to explain Jesus?
How did John answer?
faqs.answer: With examples of treating others right and doing no harm.

faqs.question: What is the Spirit’s goal?
faqs.answer: To guide us into all truth.

faqs.question: By what are we born again?
What does the word do to our conscience?
faqs.answer: It discerns right from wrong and exposes the heart.

faqs.question: Why did religious leaders reject Christ?
faqs.answer: He taught the word differently than they did.

faqs.question: Do good and evil grow together?
faqs.answer: Yes—but the church can’t just sit by.

faqs.question: What would the world know?
faqs.answer: That God’s people are separate and different.
